genres.label: Mecha
genres.description: Piloted or autonomous large machines; engineering, embodiment and responsibility.

genres.label: Isekai
genres.description: Displacement into another world; adaptation, changed social rules and identity.

genres.label: Slice of Life
genres.description: Everyday work, school, home and community; small stakes can carry deep meaning.

genres.label: Horror
genres.description: Fear, dread, uncanny humans, monsters, isolation and threatened safety.

genres.label: Romance
genres.description: Attraction, boundaries, intimacy and romantic conflict across genders.

genres.label: Sports
genres.description: Athletic training, teams, competition and sporting achievement; includes motorsport formerly Racing.

genres.label: Cyberpunk
genres.description: Networked power, artificial identity, augmentation and corporate technology.

genres.label: Fantasy
genres.description: Invented worlds with extraordinary rules, cultures or creatures; not synonymous with every myth.

genres.label: Idol
genres.description: Performance, rehearsal, fandom, manufactured image and entertainment-industry relationships.

genres.label: Mystery
genres.description: Investigation, evidence and revelation; noir remains an aesthetic within this and other genres.

genres.label: Comedy
genres.description: Timing, absurdity, social observation and character-driven humour.

genres.label: Cooking
genres.description: Food craft, hospitality, kitchens, culinary rivalry and the communities around meals.

genres.label: Military
genres.description: Command, service, strategy, logistics and armed institutions; not all action is military.

genres.label: Supernatural
genres.description: Spirits and unexplained forces interacting with lived reality; need not be frightening.

genres.label: Space
genres.description: Space travel, orbital habitats, alien societies and the scale and isolation of the cosmos.

genres.label: Magical
genres.description: Spellcraft, transformations and magical ability; all genders and species, not only magical girls.

genres.label: Survival
genres.description: Wilderness, apocalypse, disaster, hostile environments, expeditions, isolation, resource scarcity and survival communities.

genres.label: Pirate
genres.description: Seafaring adventure, treasure, outlaw crews, privateers, naval conflict, exploration and swashbuckling; airship variants still require a piracy-based world.

genres.label: Martial Arts
genres.description: Hand-to-hand combat, fighting disciplines, dojos, tournament combat, martial schools, masters, students and combat philosophy.

genres.label: Mythology
genres.description: Gods, demigods, divine monsters, legendary heroes and world religious/mythic traditions adapted as grand narrative; never restricted to Norse material.

genres.label: Nordic
genres.description: Scandinavian/Norse-inspired worlds, sagas, Viking-era aesthetics, northern clans, longships, runes, fjords, shield societies and folklore; grounded politics qualify without gods.

genres.label: Samurai
genres.description: Swordsmanship, ronin and retainers caught between personal conviction, honour and feudal duty.

genres.label: Shinobi
genres.description: Stealth, infiltration, espionage and hidden techniques amid rival factions and covert operations.

genres.label: Vampire
genres.description: Vampires, dhampirs, hunters, occult organisations, bloodline politics and gothic supernatural action.

genres.label: Grimdark
genres.description: Brutal dark fantasy, cursed survivors, demons, ruined worlds, terrible bargains and victories that carry a lasting cost.

genres.label: Monster Taming
genres.description: Creatures, bonds, collecting, raising and battling; stories about trainers and partners growing together.

genres.label: Crime
genres.description: Gangs, detectives, police, heists, underworld organisations and criminal empires.

genres.label: Kaiju
genres.description: Giant monsters, defence forces, cities under siege and the ecology of impossible creatures.

genres.label: Cosmic Horror
genres.description: Unknowable entities, forbidden knowledge, cults and existential dread beyond ordinary horror.

genres.label: Arabia
genres.description: Desert kingdoms, djinn, caravan cities, ancient ruins, palace politics and sword-and-sorcery adventure.
